title: PRIMER (2004) is the WORST FILM EVER MADE

commenti.body:
Wow. Hahahahahahahahahahahahahagahahahahahababaha.

Troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll troll

I haven’t seen the movie so I have no thoughts on its quality, but I just had to comment to let you know that you sound like a cunt. 

Complaining about how “toxic” the film’s fans are, then calling it objectively bad and preemptively dismissing their opinions in the same breath? Not only are you being hypocritical, you’re acting insecure and suggesting that your criticisms are fact while everyone else is wrong. Why are you here? You’re not looking for discussion, you’re looking for someone to pat you on the head and say “good boy” for not liking a popular movie. Nice work, dickhead, you have accomplished nothing here. 

Actually though, you have encouraged me to finally check Primer out so I can have an opinion on the film next time it’s brought up on this sub. So congratulations, you earned this movie you despise another purchase.

Why are you being so aggressive and dismissive?

It sounds like you are doing exactly what you accuse your imaginary opponents to be doing, being elitist, insisting your opinion is objectively correct, and belittling those who disagree.

Film discussion isn't about proving to people that you are right and they are wrong, it's about sharing and discovering different perspectives on art.

I earnestly suggest you find a healthy and respectful way of communicating yourself.
